notes: kuna-fixes cases: classes Vineflower 1.12.0 fails on that a kuna fix decompiles. Each runs in compat and in default mode on the fixture's base map plus `options`; maintained by tests/jvm/kuna_fix_case.py, read by regen.py.

cases.summary: `objects` and `shapes`, which pass `factory::create` on a `Factory<?>`/`ShapeFactory<?>` receiver to a generic `map`, decompile to their source; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone
`create` and `attempt`, whose `catch (Throwable)` handlers start with `if (!flag)`, decompile to their source; `read`, a try-with-resources on a nullable resource, is still rebuilt as one

`assertThenTryFinally` decompiles; `tryFinallyThenCode` and `tryCatchReturn` keep the code after the if on the path through the try (Vineflower skips it with a `break`), and `tryFinallyThenReturn` keeps its source shape; the recompiled class's `javap -c -p` equals the original's

the eight methods whose switch expression yields a string or class literal next to an arm of another reference type (a boxed char, int or boolean, a StringBuilder, a Class), as an argument, a returned value, a local and inside a lambda, decompile to their source; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone

`read`, `readThree`, `readOrDefault`, `readGuarded` and `readFinally` (a `while (true)` after other code around a `try` whose two or three `catch` blocks all go back to the loop) decompile to their source, `readOrDefault`'s `break` as `return -1` in its `catch` block, the way Vineflower prints such a `break`; the failure comments and bytecode listings are gone
